label: heart-s1
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Only input fan-out needed splitting (slope:2, ca x3, restecg:0, oldpeak). Four of five hidden ReLUs are affine or near-affine on the train domain (1173, 2245 always active; 664 clips <=0.07; 2009 clips 15/242), so their annotations describe relays rather than distinct concepts. 9 unconnected inputs (age, sex:1, fbs:0, restecg:2, exang:1, slope:1, slope:3, thal:4, thal:7) listed as root entries.
tool_bugs: Root composition plain latex drops child terms (used latex_collapsed). Forward output equals relu(z) to 3.6e-15 (output node is ReLU). Tool compositional_coverage always 1.0.
summary: Essentially logistic regression: 15 direct edges carry logit SD 5.3 of 7.0. ca enters by three parallel affine routes; cp:3 only via affine relay 1173; 2009 adds a small negative max-heart-rate term. The one consequential nonlinearity is gate 1801 = ReLU(1.48 restecg:0 + 0.805 oldpeak - 1.43): ST depression adds risk mainly when resting ECG is normal. Replacing all ReLUs by identity drops train AUC 0.939 -> 0.916, almost all from 1801.
